summary: This episode is an interview with Mia Brunell-Livfors, CEO of Axel Johnson, who was awarded Årets Ledare 2020. The discussion focuses on her leadership philosophy, transformation work at Axel Johnson including digitalization and e-commerce expansion, the impact of COVID-19 on retail operations, and diversity initiatives. No specific investment recommendations are provided.
key_takeaways: Axel Johnson transformed under her leadership with e-commerce growing from minimal to 25% of revenues
COVID-19 accelerated digital transformation in retail by years in just weeks
Axel Johnson focuses on decentralization and diversity (26% international background employees)
